problem_restatement.input: V81 found three native fifteen-minute ZEC family-sides with at least twelve trades and positive stress net PnL, but each failed after removal of its largest winner.
problem_restatement.required_output: Test whether one uniform two-reward-to-one-risk exit converts those uncapped, tail-dependent paths into a bounded repeatable lifecycle.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: An unchanged family-side passes development, validation, and holdout under 14- and 20-bps round-trip friction, including largest-winner removal.

parent_evidence.selection_rule: Retain family-sides with at least twelve completed development trades and positive net PnL under both frozen friction profiles; do not rank by PnL.

data_and_chronology_contract.opening_rule: Replay all three candidates in development; open validation only for complete development survivors; open holdout only for complete validation survivors; make no further parameter or direction changes.

candidate_contract.entry_timing: completed native fifteen-minute signal, next-bar open

falsifiers: no candidate clears development under both friction profiles
a validation survivor fails untouched holdout
largest-winner removal makes any required result non-positive
fewer than twelve trades resolve in any required partition
runtime parity cannot be implemented and tested without weakening the frozen contract

development_result.finding: Zero-lag short passed nominal costs but lost money at 20-bps round-trip stress; both long candidates were negative under nominal and stress profiles.
